notes.title: Build 1.1.7 is out !!
notes.content:
Hey Hirocatos, this new build includes:

- New Level Progression Logic: You can now play and progress through unplayed levels without having to complete the entire story. Just pass a level, and the next one will unlock!
- Crowd Control Integration: We've integrated Crowd Control into the Hirocato codebase! If you're a streamer looking for some chaotic but fun runs, there's now a dedicated option in the menu.
I hope these updates make the Hirocato experience even more enjoyable for everyone.

Bye!

notes.title: New non-stop mode out!! + bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I'm happy to announce that the first update for Hirocato - The Delivery Hero has been pushed and includes:

- New Classic Running (non-stop) mode 🚀
- Improved visual effects/filters that do not interfere with gameplay 📷
- Camera distance option added to the pause menu (Close, Mid, Far) 📏
- Camera display option added to the pause menu to switch between: Fullscreen / Windowed 🪟
- Camera following style option added to switch between: Fixed / Smooth 📸
- Backward climbing bug fixed 🪲
- Minor bugs and improvements 🐱

Version: 1.0.5

Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and shared your thoughts on what could be improved!

Best, 
Gabriel
